calls.reason: OpenAI's report documents persistent hallucination and reasoning errors, and even the most favourable study (Bubeck et al.) calls GPT-4 only an early, incomplete step with clear limits, not an AGI for arbitrary tasks.

Studies in each named domain show robustness failures: NEWTON's uneven physics results, 0% on altered theory-of-mind categories, and poor transfer to varied GSM-Plus maths problems. The Nature ToM study tempers but does not overturn this.
Richelieu's ablation found vanilla LLM Diplomacy play relatively poor; Talk2Drive needed an Autoware controller and Alter3 only did poses. Nothing shows unaided GPT-4 doing any of the three.
Only a secondary estimate (about 13 trillion tokens) is available. There is no verified corpus comparison and no measure of what share of the internet it covers.

Uncensored WormGPT variants built on Grok and Mixtral, and a propaganda campaign traced to uncensored Llama-3 fine-tunes, show guardrail-free knock-offs used for malicious content, alongside downloadable GPT-4-competitive Llama 3.1.
GPT-4-0613 scored under 40% on complex schema-following, but function calling and structured outputs changed integration. No end-to-end reliability measurement settles the claim.
